Assets and licences

Every third-party file the site ships, or that the room bake uses, has a row here. Hand-made assets are listed too. The /credits page and the SaahilOS Credits app render this file.

The site is based on Henry Heffernan's portfolio (portfolio-website, MIT; portfolio-inner-site, used with his permission), heavily edited. Ideas from Alana Goyal's site (MIT). See NOTICE.
